title: Pride & Joy #2 3 4 Lot DC Vertigo 1997 Garth Ennis John Higgins Mini-Series
condition_description: All three covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Pride & Joy #2, #3 and #4 of 4 (August-October 1997), DC/Vertigo - written by Garth Ennis (Preacher, The Boys), art and covers by John Higgins. Suggested for mature readers. $2.50 cover price each. Issues 2-4 of the 4-issue series (no #1).

You get all 3 issues:
- #2 - back cover: Batman & Robin movie ad
- #3 - back cover: Mimic movie ad
- #4 (final issue) - back cover: The Space Bar CD-ROM game ad

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
